taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FEIS's field horsetail review (Sullivan 1993, read 2026-10-15): sterile stems "are usually from 2 to 24 inches (5-60 cm) tall, rarely to 40 inches (1 m) tall".

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's field horsetail review (Sullivan 1993, read 2026-10-15): sterile stems "rarely to 40 inches (1 m) tall".

traits.cone_length_m.note: FEIS's field horsetail review (Sullivan 1993, read 2026-10-15): "The strobili are from 0.4 to 1.4 inches (1-3.5 cm) long, peduncled, and blunt", on pale fertile stems 5-30 cm tall that the sterile-stem drawing leaves out.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) pp. 326-327, Equisetum arvense: aboveground stems deciduous.

generator.params.note: Giant horsetail's values, made smaller and finer for field horsetail's sterile stems: up to 20 whorls of slender branches (FEIS, Sullivan 1993) drawn as 14, branches angling upward (Fern Grower's Manual pp. 326-327), a looser clump from its creeping rhizomes. The stem height comes from the stated height by the rule. Branch length and counts by eye; not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 35 cm at 4 years in the open, about the middle of FEIS's 5-60 cm for sterile stems (Sullivan 1993). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green branches (Fern Grower's Manual pp. 326-327, "fine, feathery, bright-green aspect") on green stems, greener than giant horsetail's pale ones.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2910663), as no source read gives it.

traits.perennation.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2910663), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2910663), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2910663), as no source read gives it.
